original_request: 레퍼런스 이미지에 있는 석등을 제작하라. 석등은 중앙의 사각형 구멍을 포함한 실루엣이 명확히 나와야 한다.
reference_observations: {"observed":["Broad, low gray-brown stone roof with sloping faces, projecting eaves, and a raised central cap.","Box-shaped chamber below the roof with dark rectangular-to-square openings and thick stone borders.","Broad horizontal platform beneath the chamber.","Squat lower support with curved legs and arch-shaped gaps.","Weathered stone surfaces and softened edges.","A foreground pole obscures the central chamber and lower structure; a person obscures part of the left silhouette."],"inferred":["Hidden faces, exact support count, internal cavity construction, and absolute dimensions require conservative reconstruction.","The pole and person are separate foreground objects and should be excluded."],"reason_summary":{"goal":"Reconstruct the referenced stone lantern with a clearly readable central square opening.","strategy":"Reference-driven mesh construction supplies deliberate silhouette control and a real chamber opening.","evidence":"Fresh GLB import, canonical views, and additional aperture-detail views support independent assessment.","resources":"Multiple local corrections and explicitly restarted runs accommodate occlusion and strategy revision."}}

acceptance_criteria.description: The GLB faithfully reconstructs the visible stone-lantern silhouette: broad low sloping roof with projecting eaves and raised central cap, box-shaped lantern chamber, broad supporting platform, and squat curved supports forming arch-shaped gaps. Preserve their relative proportions and arrangement.

The central square opening is a real geometric opening through the lantern-chamber wall into an interior cavity, with four clearly readable boundaries. It remains clearly visible in independent fresh-import front and aperture-detail views; a painted dark patch, shallow recess, opaque insert, or foreground obstruction does not satisfy this criterion.
The lantern has a restrained weathered gray-brown stone appearance and softened edges consistent with the reference. Surface detail preserves the recognizable silhouette and square opening.

Deliver a complete standalone stone lantern. Exclude the foreground person and vertical pole, trees, surrounding rocks, and photographic background. Infer occluded and hidden portions conservatively from the visible structure.

Deliver an inspectable GLB that successfully imports into a fresh Blender scene with intact meshes, materials, plausible bounds, and the complete lantern. Independent rendered evidence must depict this imported deliverable.

interpretation_envelope: Use the supplied current-reference image as visual authority; no earlier model, specification, or review is assumed.
Absolute dimensions are unspecified. Use a coherent modeling scale and preserve visible proportions; physical size is an inference.
Reconstruct hidden faces and support count conservatively using structural continuity and approximate symmetry; do not claim they were observed.
The foreground vertical pole is an occluder, not a lantern component. Restore the lantern behind it.
The roof's central raised cap is visible; any higher finial shape is insufficiently resolved and should remain restrained.
The chamber opening must be actual mesh geometry into a cavity. Matching visible adjacent openings is appropriate; unsupported ornament and interior fixtures are unnecessary.
Use reviewed headless Blender mesh authoring and GLB export. Comfy endpoint readiness does not establish model or generation readiness.
Independent fresh-import renders establish visual evidence. Geometry reports do not automatically establish aperture topology.
Freeze this specification across bounded local corrections and Workflow revisions; semantic REVISE may lead to another Attempt or an explicitly restarted Production Run within the resource envelope.
